span.p:
TRAINING - BertNERDataset.__getitem__
LongTensor of label ids -> BertForTokenClassification
CrossEntropy ignores -100, so sub-word pieces and padding
contribute no loss and no accuracy denominator

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INFERENCE - dataset.align_word_ids
same walk, but emits 0 for a first piece and -100 otherwise
-100 0 0 0 -100 0 0 -100 -100 0 0 -100

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

evaluate_one_text:
logits[0][mask != -100] keeps exactly one row per word
argmax -> IDS_TO_LABELS -> one tag per input word

div.style: color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Guard rails in dataset._word_label_id: an IndexError(more words than
labels) or an unknown tag is logged and masked with -100 rather than
crashing or silently mislabelling. Covered by tests/test_alignment.py.
